summary_en: ITG-G Holdings has filed an amended tender offer statement on November 11, 2026, for Kadoya Sesame Mills ordinary shares. The amendment reflects corrections to the original tender offer filing dated September 15, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Amendment to the Announcement Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Ordinary Shares of Kadoya Sesame Mills Incorporated Due to Filing of Amended Tender Offer Statement by ITG-G Holdings Corporation
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, ITG-G Holdings Corporation filed an amended tender offer statement with the Kanto Local Finance Bureau regarding its tender offer for ordinary shares of Kadoya Sesame Mills Incorporated (ticker code 2612, listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard). This amendment filing was made in accordance with provisions of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act (Act No. 25 of 1948), as amended.

The amendment follows the original tender offer filing submitted on September 15, 2026, which had previously been subject to correction filings dated September 25, October 8, and October 29, 2026. The current amendment necessitated further corrections to the tender offer documentation.

The announcement of the tender offer commencement, originally dated September 14, 2026, is being updated to reflect these amendments. The detailed contents of the amended announcement are attached to this notice. The disclosure was made at the request of ITG-G Holdings in accordance with the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Enforcement Order.
